links.label: Counts as Kobold
links.description: Carrier counts as Kobold, helping activate Kobold traits and extending the cup's attack speed bonus to matching pieces.

links.label: Counts as Aqir
links.description: Carrier also counts as Aqir and can participate in friendly Infection spawning.

links.label: Mech (3) reward
links.description: Normal Heart of the Machine reward: refresh your recruitment panel for free after meeting the Mech survival condition.

links.label: Mech (6) golden reward
links.description: Golden Heart of the Machine reward: discover five random legendary chess pieces and recruit them with the granted tokens.

links.label: Golden Heart token
links.description: Token granted by Golden Heart of the Machine for recruiting discovered legendary pieces.
